name: Send a sign-in code and verify access
description: Verifies the primary sign-in flow moves from credentials to email verification and then into the banking dashboard.
steps: Enter a non-empty email or mobile number and password
Use the verification code received by email
expected: The verification screen appears after sign-in, and a valid email code opens the banking dashboard.

name: Reject an invalid verification code
description: Verifies that a malformed or invalid verification code does not grant dashboard access.
steps: Submit the sign-in form with non-empty credentials
Enter a six-digit code that is not the delivered code
expected: A visible invalid-or-expired code message appears and the dashboard remains locked.

name: Create account flow
description: Verifies the account creation screen validates required fields and remains usable on a mobile viewport.
steps: Leave at least one required field empty
expected: A visible required-field message appears and no account setup confirmation is created.

name: Dashboard account visibility controls
description: Verifies the authenticated dashboard presents accounts and activity and lets the user hide balances.
steps: Review the account and recent activity sections
expected: Balances are masked after toggling, while account names and recent activity remain visible.
